entities.name: Frédéric Alfred Pierre, comte de Falloux
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Frédéric-Alfred-Pierre, comte de Falloux was a French politician and author, famous for having given his name to two laws on education, favoring private Catholic teaching. He was the younger brother of Cardinal Frédéric de Falloux (1807–1884)
